thread:
Maya (PM): Heads-up — competitor shipped 'Satellite' feature yesterday. Customers asking for equivalent. Quick sync: do we pull this into Q2 scope? Need decision by EOD.
Liam (Eng): Can we get a short spec on what 'equivalent' means? Is it runtime routing + per-tenant configs or just API surface?
Maya (PM): From sales: basic API parity (per-route toggles + consistent fallbacks). No multi-model routing initially. Nora, correct?
Nora (Sales): yep — three pilots asked for per-route toggles and same fallback behavior. Revenue: ~ $180k ARR if we ship in 6-8 wks. If delayed, they likely wait.
Jon (Infra): perf/time impact depends on batching changes. If we add per-route toggles we might reduce batching efficiency by ~10-15% unless we implement route-aware batching.
Liam (Eng): estimate: 5 dev-weeks + 2 infra-weeks for route-aware batching and basic UI flags. Can cut scope: minimal parity = toggle + simple fallback (1-2 wks infra). Tradeoff: cost per token increases.
Priya (Product): Proposal: two-path plan. (A) Minimal parity: API toggle + fallback, ship in 3 wks to pilots. (B) Full infra route-aware batching + rollout, ship in 8 wks with cost regression mitigations. Agree? 
Cam (Design): Minimal parity needs a small console flow — 1 designer day. I can do a quick mock.
Nora (Sales): Pilots will accept minimal parity if we commit to full plan within quarter. They care timeline.
Maya (PM): Launch criteria for minimal parity: (1) API toggle + docs, (2) pilot onboarding guide, (3) telemetry on latency & token cost, (4) rollback path. If all green, we consider full infra follow-up.
Liam (Eng): ok for minimal, but add a hard SLO for 95th latency and a test harness for batching. Without that, ops will get paged.
Jon (Infra): I'll prep a canary plan + infra metrics. Can we set cost-alert thresholds? 
Priya (Product): I'll write a one-pager with acceptance criteria and coordinate pilot sign-up.
Maya (PM): Decision: ship minimal parity as a gated pilot. Owners: Priya (spec), Liam (implementation), Jon (canary+infra), Cam (console), Nora (pilot comms). Target first pilot in 3 weeks. 
Nora (Sales): added to pilot list: AcmeCloud, BrightDoc. I'll sync them and manage expectations.
Liam (Eng): filing spike ticket now: ROUTE-PARITY-451. ETA: first patch in 5 business days.
deploy-bot: New ticket ROUTE-PARITY-451 created by Liam (Eng) — https://redwood/issue/451 :eyes:
Maya (PM): Thanks all. We'll reconvene Tuesday morning for status. :thumbsup:
